LESSON: FOOD AND FITNESS NUTRITION

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Foods and
Topic 3.3: Food and fitness Nutrition

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Food and fitness Nutrition. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why do we eat food?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Food and fitness Nutrition
2. Give Kenyan examples for Food and fitness Nutrition
3. Practise Food and fitness Nutrition at school and at home
